_source: https://github.com/ekelen/tarot-api/blob/master/static/card_data.json （static/card_data.json，内容逐字取自 A. E. Waite《The Pictorial Key to the Tarot》1911 年版，公有领域）
_note: en.* 为 Waite 1911 原文占卜词表（meaning_up / meaning_rev 的完整条目，比常见现代牌义表更全、含人物牌的传统人物含义）；cn.* 为本项目精炼中文对照（关键词式，每条 1 句），与 site/data/tarot.json 的单句式解读互补使用：tarot.json 管『读起来像话』，本文件管『词根可组合』。
_usage: 组合解读引擎可按 kw 拆词根做牌与牌关系推导；人物牌（Page/Knight/Queen/King）的 Waite 原文含传统『人物侧写』含义，现有语料缺这部分，可用于问『某人』类问题。

en.up: Folly, mania, extravagance, intoxication, delirium, frenzy, bewrayment.
en.rev: Negligence, absence, distribution, carelessness, apathy, nullity, vanity.

cn.up: 忘乎所以的狂喜、不计后果的开端、痴迷与放纵。
cn.rev: 疏忽、心不在焉、冷漠、虚无、徒劳。

en.up: Skill, diplomacy, address, subtlety; sickness, pain, loss, disaster, snares of enemies; self-confidence, will; the Querent, if male.
en.rev: Physician, Magus, mental disease, disgrace, disquiet.

cn.up: 技艺与手腕、自信与意志、以智取胜；亦含病痛与敌暗算的双面义。
cn.rev: 医师／智者的身份义；心疾、失态、不安。

en.up: Secrets, mystery, the future as yet unrevealed; the woman who interests the Querent; silence, tenacity; mystery, wisdom, science.
en.rev: Passion, moral or physical ardour, conceit, surface knowledge.

cn.up: 秘密与未知、沉默与坚韧、秘传的智慧与学问。
cn.rev: 炽情、自负、一知半解的表层知识。

en.up: Fruitfulness, action, initiative, length of days; the unknown, clandestine; also difficulty, doubt, ignorance.
en.rev: Light, truth, the unravelling of involved matters, public rejoicings; according to another reading, vacillation.

cn.up: 丰饶与多产、主动作为、绵长福泽；亦含隐秘与疑难。
cn.rev: 真相大白、难题解开、公开的喜事；另一解：犹豫不决。

en.up: Stability, power, protection, realization; a great person; aid, reason, conviction; also authority and will.
en.rev: Benevolence, compassion, credit; also confusion to enemies, obstruction, immaturity.

cn.up: 稳固、权力与庇护、理性与信念、权威与意志。
cn.rev: 仁慈与宽恕、信誉；亦含阻碍与不成熟。

en.up: Marriage, alliance, captivity, servitude; by another account, mercy and goodness; inspiration; the man to whom the Querent has recourse.
en.rev: Society, good understanding, concord, overkindness, weakness.

cn.up: 婚约与同盟、受制与束缚、良师与依靠、灵感。
cn.rev: 社交与谅解、和睦；过度的善意即软弱。

en.up: Attraction, love, beauty, trials overcome.
en.rev: Failure, foolish designs. Another account speaks of marriage frustrated and contrarieties of all kinds.

cn.up: 吸引与爱、美、渡过试炼。
cn.rev: 失算与愚蠢的计划、婚事受挫、诸事相违。

en.up: Succour, providence also war, triumph, presumption, vengeance, trouble.
en.rev: Riot, quarrel, dispute, litigation, defeat.

cn.up: 驰援与护佑、战争与凯旋；亦含僭越与祸患。
cn.rev: 骚乱、口角、争端、诉讼、败北。

en.up: Power, energy, action, courage, magnanimity; also complete success and honours.
en.rev: Despotism, abuse of power, weakness, discord, sometimes even disgrace.

cn.up: 力量与行动、勇气与宽宏、圆满成功与荣誉。
cn.rev: 专横与滥权、软弱与失和，甚或蒙羞。

en.up: Prudence, circumspection; also and especially treason, dissimulation, roguery, corruption.
en.rev: Concealment, disguise, policy, fear, unreasoned caution.

cn.up: 审慎与周虑；亦含背叛、伪装与堕落的警示义。
cn.rev: 藏匿与掩饰、权谋、恐惧、无谓的过度谨慎。

en.up: Destiny, fortune, success, elevation, luck, felicity.
en.rev: Increase, abundance, superfluity.

cn.up: 命运与机运、成功与跃升、福气。
cn.rev: 增益与丰盛，过犹不及的『多』。

en.up: Equity, rightness, probity, executive; triumph of the deserving side in law.
en.rev: Law in all its departments, legal complications, bigotry, bias, excessive severity.

cn.up: 公平与正直、执行力、有理者胜诉。
cn.rev: 法律纠纷、偏执与偏袒、执法过苛。

en.up: Wisdom, circumspection, discernment, trials, sacrifice, intuition, divination, prophecy.
en.rev: Selfishness, the crowd, body politic.

cn.up: 智慧与明辨、试炼与牺牲、直觉与预言。
cn.rev: 自私自利、随波逐流的群体性。

en.up: End, mortality, destruction, corruption; also, for a man, the loss of a benefactor; for a woman, many contrarieties; for a maid, failure of marriage projects.
en.rev: Inertia, sleep, lethargy, petrifaction, somnambulism; hope destroyed.

cn.up: 终结与死生、毁坏与朽坏；亦指恩主之失、诸事乖违。
cn.rev: 僵滞与昏睡、木然麻木、希望破灭。

en.up: Economy, moderation, frugality, management, accommodation.
en.rev: Things connected with churches, religions, sects, the priesthood; also disunion, unfortunate combinations, competing interests.

cn.up: 节制与俭省、经营与协调、从容调度。
cn.rev: 教派与神职相关之事；失和、组合失当、利益相争。

en.up: Ravage, violence, vehemence, extraordinary efforts, force, fatality; that which is predestined but is not for this reason evil.
en.rev: Evil fatality, weakness, pettiness, blindness.

cn.up: 狂暴与强力、殊死的努力、宿命之力（宿命未必为恶）。
cn.rev: 恶性的宿命、孱弱、琐碎、蒙蔽。

en.up: Misery, distress, indigence, adversity, calamity, disgrace, deception, ruin. It is a card in particular of unforeseen catastrophe.
en.rev: According to one account, the same in a lesser degree; also oppression, imprisonment, tyranny.

cn.up: 困苦与灾厄、耻辱与欺瞒、倾覆——尤指飞来横祸。
cn.rev: 同类灾祸较轻的一档；亦指压迫、禁锢、暴虐。

en.up: Loss, theft, privation, abandonment; another reading says—hope and bright prospects.
en.rev: Arrogance, haughtiness, impotence.

cn.up: 失窃与匮乏、被弃；另一解：希望与光明前景。
cn.rev: 傲慢与倨傲、力不从心。

en.up: Hidden enemies, danger, calumny, darkness, terror, deception, occult forces, error.
en.rev: Instability, inconstancy, silence, lesser degrees of deception and error.

cn.up: 暗敌与危险、中伤与黑暗、欺诈与迷误、隐秘之力。
cn.rev: 动摇与反复、沉默、程度较轻的欺瞒与谬误。

en.up: Material happiness, fortunate marriage, contentment.
en.rev: The same in a lesser sense.

cn.up: 现世的幸福、美满姻缘、心满意足。
cn.rev: 同义但程度较轻，喜中略有折损。

en.up: Change of position, renewal, outcome. Another account specifies total loss though lawsuit.
en.rev: Weakness, pusillanimity, simplicity; also deliberation, decision, sentence.

cn.up: 地位变更、更新与结局；另一解：因讼大损。
cn.rev: 怯懦与天真；亦指深思、裁决与判词。

en.up: Assured success, recompense, voyage, route, emigration, flight, change of place.
en.rev: Inertia, fixity, stagnation, permanence.

cn.up: 稳操的成功与回报、远行与迁居、换环境。
cn.rev: 惰性与凝滞、原地不动、局面的固化。

en.up: Creation, invention, enterprise, the powers which result in these; principle, beginning, source; birth, family, origin; the starting point of enterprises; according to another account, money, fortune, inheritance.
en.rev: Fall, decadence, ruin, perdition, to perish; also a certain clouded joy.

cn.up: 创造与发明、开创事业之力、起源与开端；另一解：钱财与遗产。
cn.rev: 衰落与倾颓、毁灭；亦指蒙尘的喜悦。

en.up: Riches, fortune, magnificence; on the other hand, physical suffering, disease, chagrin, sadness, mortification. A lord overlooking his dominion and alternately contemplating a globe.
en.rev: Surprise, wonder, enchantment, emotion, trouble, fear.

cn.up: 财富与鸿图；亦含病痛、失意与悲苦的双面义。
cn.rev: 惊讶与奇遇、迷醉、忧惧与纷扰。

en.up: Established strength, enterprise, effort, trade, commerce, discovery; able co-operation in business.
en.rev: The end of troubles, suspension or cessation of adversity, toil and disappointment.

cn.up: 已立之势、实业与商贾、探索、得力的协作。
cn.rev: 烦难将尽、逆境与辛劳告一段落。

en.up: Country life, haven of refuge, a species of domestic harvest-home, repose, concord, harmony, prosperity, peace, and the perfected work of these.
en.rev: The meaning remains unaltered; it is prosperity, increase, felicity, beauty, embellishment.

cn.up: 田园安居、休憩与和睦、家宅丰登、功成之作。
cn.rev: 义不变：兴盛、增益、福乐与添彩。

en.up: Imitation, sham fight, but also the strenuous competition and struggle of the search after riches and fortune; some attributions say gold, gain, opulence.
en.rev: Litigation, disputes, trickery, contradiction.

cn.up: 模拟与演练、为求财获利的激烈竞争；另一解：得金与富足。
cn.rev: 诉讼与争端、诡诈、彼此相左。

en.up: A victor triumphing; great news carried in state by the King's courier; expectation crowned with its own desire, the crown of hope.
en.rev: Apprehension, fear, as of a victorious enemy at the gate; treachery, disloyalty; also indefinite delay.

cn.up: 凯旋与捷报、所望所求终得加冕。
cn.rev: 忧惧如败兵压境、背叛与不忠、遥遥无期的延宕。

en.up: Valour; six attacking one who has the vantage position; discussion, wordy strife; negotiations, war of trade, competition; a card of success.
en.rev: Perplexity, embarrassments, anxiety; a caution against indecision.

cn.up: 踞高临下的勇气、论战与谈判、商战与竞争——终属成功之牌。
cn.rev: 困窘与焦虑；警惕优柔寡断。

en.up: Activity in undertakings, swiftness, great haste, great hope, speed towards an assured felicity; that which is on the move; also the arrows of love.
en.rev: Arrows of jealousy, internal dispute, stingings of conscience, quarrels; domestic disputes.

cn.up: 事业骤速、疾行与厚望、奔向可期之福；亦指爱神之箭。
cn.rev: 嫉妒之矢、内讧与良心刺痛、争吵与家内不和。

en.up: Strength in opposition; meeting an onslaught boldly; delay, suspension, adjournment.
en.rev: Obstacles, adversity, calamity.

cn.up: 迎击之力、正面硬撼；亦指延期与暂缓。
cn.rev: 障碍与逆境、祸患。

en.up: Oppression simply; also fortune, gain, any kind of success; a card of false-seeming, disguise, perfidy. Success is stultified if the Nine of Swords follows.
en.rev: Contrarieties, difficulties, intrigues, and their analogies.

cn.up: 重压与负荷；亦指财利与成功；兼有虚饰与欺瞒义。
cn.rev: 乖违与困难、暗中搅局。

en.up: Dark young man, faithful, a lover, an envoy, a postman; favourable testimony; a dangerous rival if followed by the Page of Cups; has the chief qualities of his suit; may signify family intelligence.
en.rev: Anecdotes, announcements, evil news; indecision and the instability which accompanies it.

cn.up: 忠实的年轻人、传信者与使者；具本花色诸质；亦指家中音讯。
cn.rev: 传闻与公告、噩耗；摇摆不定。

en.up: Departure, absence, flight, emigration; a dark young man, friendly; change of residence.
en.rev: Rupture, division, interruption, discord.

cn.up: 启程与远走、离乡迁居；友善的年轻人。
cn.rev: 决裂与分裂、中断、失和。

en.up: A dark woman, countrywoman, friendly, chaste, loving, honourable; love of money, or a certain success in business.
en.rev: Good, economical, obliging, serviceable; also opposition, jealousy, even deceit and infidelity, in certain positions.

cn.up: 亲切可敬的女性、贞静有爱；亦指爱财、生意小成。
cn.rev: 勤俭而乐于助人；特定牌位下亦指敌意、嫉妒、欺瞒与不忠。

en.up: Dark man, friendly, countryman, generally married, honest and conscientious; the card always signifies honesty; news concerning an unexpected heritage.
en.rev: Good, but severe; austere, yet tolerant.

cn.up: 诚实有担待的男性、意外遗产的消息；此牌恒指诚信。
cn.rev: 良善而严厉、清峻却宽容。

en.up: House of the true heart, joy, content, abode, nourishment, abundance, fertility; Holy Table, felicity hereof.
en.rev: House of the false heart, mutation, instability, revolution.

cn.up: 真心之宅、喜乐与满足、滋养与丰饶。
cn.rev: 假意之宅、变故、不稳、颠覆。

en.up: Love, passion, friendship, affinity, union, concord, sympathy, the interrelation of the sexes.
en.rev: Lust, cupidity, jealousy, wish, desire.

cn.up: 爱与情谊、两情相契、结合与和睦。
cn.rev: 贪欲与占有、嫉妒、单方面的欲求。

en.up: The conclusion of any matter in plenty, perfection and merriment; happy issue, victory, fulfilment, solace, healing.
en.rev: Expedition, dispatch, achievement, end; also the side of excess in physical enjoyment, and the pleasures of the senses.

cn.up: 丰美圆满的收束、喜果与痊愈、慰藉。
cn.rev: 速成与收尾；亦指感官享乐之过度。

en.up: Weariness, disgust, aversion, imaginary vexations, satiety; another wine is offered the wastrel, but he sees no consolation therein; a card of blended pleasure.
en.rev: Novelty, presage, new instruction, new relations.

cn.up: 倦怠与厌腻、想象出来的烦忧、福至而不觉。
cn.rev: 新奇与预兆、新的指点、新的关系。

en.up: A card of loss, but something remains over; three have been taken, but two are left; a card of inheritance, patrimony, transmission, but not corresponding to expectations; with some interpreters, marriage not without bitterness.
en.rev: News, alliances, affinity, consanguinity, ancestry, return, false projects.

cn.up: 有失而未尽失——三倾二立；继承与传承、不如所期。
cn.rev: 音讯与结盟、亲缘与归返、虚妄的计划。

en.up: A card of the past and of memories, looking back on childhood; happiness coming rather from the past; another reading gives new relations, new knowledge, new environment.
en.rev: The future, renewal, that which will come to pass presently.

cn.up: 怀旧与童年记忆、来自过去的快乐；另一解：新环境新关系。
cn.rev: 未来将至之事、更新与到来。

en.up: Fairy favours, images of reflection, sentiment, imagination, things seen in the glass of contemplation; some attainment, but nothing permanent or substantial.
en.rev: Desire, will, determination, project.

cn.up: 镜花水月的意象、情思与想象、有小得而无恒产。
cn.rev: 欲念与意志、决心与规划。

en.up: The decline of a matter, or that a matter thought important is really of slight consequence; other readings antithetical: joy, mildness, timidity, honour, modesty.
en.rev: Great joy, happiness, feasting.

cn.up: 事态消退、自以为重者实为轻末；另一解：谦和与体面。
cn.rev: 大喜与欢宴。

en.up: Concord, contentment, physical bien-être; also victory, success, advantage; satisfaction for the Querent.
en.rev: Truth, loyalty, liberty; but the readings vary and include mistakes, imperfections.

cn.up: 和睦与满足、身心安适、胜算与实利。
cn.rev: 真话与忠诚、自在；另解：差错与不圆满。

en.up: Contentment, repose of the entire heart; perfection of human love and friendship; the town, village or country inhabited by the Querent.
en.rev: Repose of the false heart, indignation, violence.

cn.up: 全心安顿、人间爱与友爱的圆满、家宅之邦。
cn.rev: 假意安顿、愤懑与暴戾。

en.up: Fair young man, impelled to render service; a studious youth; news, message; application, reflection, meditation.
en.rev: Taste, inclination, attachment, seduction, deception, artifice.

cn.up: 乐于效劳的少年、勤思好学；音讯与消息。
cn.rev: 嗜好与依恋、诱惑与巧诈。

en.up: Arrival, approach—sometimes that of a messenger; advances, proposition, invitation, incitement.
en.rev: Trickery, artifice, subtlety, swindling, duplicity, fraud.

cn.up: 到来与趋近（常为信使）、提议与邀约、鼓动。
cn.rev: 机巧与手腕、诓骗与两面手法。

en.up: Good, fair woman; honest, devoted woman who will do service; loving intelligence, the gift of vision; success, happiness, pleasure; wisdom, virtue; a perfect spouse and a good mother.
en.rev: The accounts vary; distinguished woman but one not to be trusted; perverse woman; vice, dishonour, depravity.

cn.up: 良善的女性、深情的智慧与远见、贤妻良母之象。
cn.rev: 诸解不一：不可尽信的显贵女子；失德与败坏。

en.up: Fair man, man of business, law, or divinity; responsible, disposed to oblige; equity, art and science; creative intelligence.
en.rev: Dishonest, double-dealing man; roguery, exaction, injustice, vice, scandal, pillage, considerable loss.

cn.up: 务实公正的男性（商/法/神职）、创造力、乐于成人之美。
cn.rev: 两面三刀之人、不义与丑闻、重大损失。

en.up: Triumph, the excessive degree in everything, conquest, triumph of force; a card of great force, in love as well as in hatred.
en.rev: The same, but the results are disastrous; another account says—conception, childbirth, augmentation, multiplicity.

cn.up: 彻底的征服、凡事臻于极致、爱与恨皆大力的极端之牌。
cn.rev: 同类大力但结果成灾；另一解：受孕、生育、增殖。

en.up: Conformity and the equipoise which it suggests, courage, friendship, concord in a state of arms; another reading: tenderness, affection, intimacy.
en.rev: Imposture, falsehood, duplicity, disloyalty.

cn.up: 均衡与相持、武装下的和局；另一解：柔情与亲昵。
cn.rev: 冒名与虚妄、口是心非、不忠。

en.up: Removal, absence, delay, division, rupture, dispersion.
en.rev: Mental alienation, error, loss, distraction, disorder, confusion.

cn.up: 离去与缺席、延宕与分离、决裂。
cn.rev: 心智迷乱、过错与损失、失序。

en.up: Vigilance, retreat, solitude, hermit's repose, exile, tomb and coffin.
en.rev: Wise administration, circumspection, economy, avarice, precaution, testament.

cn.up: 警戒与退守、独处与休憩、放逐；墓与棺的终局意象。
cn.rev: 稳妥的操持、节俭与戒备、遗嘱。

en.up: Degradation, destruction, revocation, infamy, dishonour, loss.
en.rev: The same; burial and obsequies.

cn.up: 败落与撤销、羞辱与损失。
cn.rev: 同前义；葬仪与收场。

en.up: Journey by water, route, way, envoy, commissionary, expedient.
en.rev: Declaration, confession, publicity; a proposal of love.

cn.up: 水路之旅、路线与通道、使者与权宜之计。
cn.rev: 坦白与公开；亦有爱的告白一解。

en.up: Design, attempt, wish, hope, confidence; also quarrelling, a plan that may fail, annoyance.
en.rev: Good advice, counsel, instruction, slander, babbling.

cn.up: 图谋与尝试、期望与自信；亦指争执与可能落空的计划。
cn.rev: 良策与指点；亦指中伤与碎语。

en.up: Bad news, violent chagrin, crisis, censure, power in trammels, conflict, calumny; also sickness.
en.rev: Disquiet, difficulty, opposition, accident, treachery; what is unforeseen; fatality.

cn.up: 噩耗与剧怒、危机与责难、受缚之力、疾病。
cn.rev: 惶惑与困难、对抗与意外、背叛与不可抗。

en.up: Death, failure, miscarriage, delay, deception, disappointment, despair.
en.rev: Imprisonment, suspicion, doubt, reasonable fear, shame.

cn.up: 夭折与挫败、延宕与欺骗、失望与绝望。
cn.rev: 困守与猜疑、合理的恐惧、羞愧。

en.up: Pain, affliction, tears, sadness, desolation; not especially a card of violent death.
en.rev: Advantage, profit, success, favour, but none of these are permanent; also power and authority.

cn.up: 剧痛与摧折、泪与凄凉（并非横死之牌）。
cn.rev: 利益与成功、眷顾与权势——但皆不长久。

en.up: Authority, overseeing, secret service, vigilance, spying, examination.
en.rev: The more evil side of these qualities; what is unforeseen, unprepared state; sickness is also intimated.

cn.up: 监察与督导、耳目与侦讯、警觉。
cn.rev: 上述诸义的恶面：猝不及防、毫无准备；亦暗示病痛。

en.up: Skill, bravery, capacity, defence, address, enmity, wrath, war, destruction, opposition, resistance, ruin.
en.rev: Imprudence, incapacity, extravagance.

cn.up: 骁勇与防御之才；亦含敌意、怒战、毁灭的锋刃面。
cn.rev: 轻率与无能、挥霍无度。

en.up: Widowhood, female sadness and embarrassment, absence, sterility, mourning, privation, separation.
en.rev: Malice, bigotry, artifice, prudery, bale, deceit.

cn.up: 孀居与哀伤、缺席与分离、贫瘠与悼亡。
cn.rev: 恶意与偏执、伪饰与欺瞒。

en.up: Whatsoever arises out of the idea of judgment and all its connexions—power, command, authority, militant intelligence, law, offices of the crown.
en.rev: Cruelty, perversity, barbarity, perfidy, evil intention.

cn.up: 审判所系的权力与号令、法度、锐智。
cn.rev: 冷酷与乖张、残暴与背信、不轨之心。

en.up: Perfect contentment, felicity, ecstasy; also speedy intelligence; gold.
en.rev: The evil side of wealth, bad intelligence; also great riches. Prosperity, comfortable material conditions, whether of advantage depending on the card's position.

cn.up: 圆满的至乐、灵通的快讯、黄金。
cn.rev: 财之恶面与坏消息；亦指巨富——物质丰裕是否为福，视牌位而定。

en.up: A card of gaiety, recreation; read also as news and messages in writing, as obstacles, agitation, trouble, embroilment.
en.rev: Enforced gaiety, simulated enjoyment, literal sense, handwriting, composition, letters of exchange.

cn.up: 欢愉与消遣；亦指书面音讯、阻碍与搅扰。
cn.rev: 强颜欢笑、佯乐；文书、手迹、票据往来的字面义。

en.up: Métier, trade, skilled labour; usually regarded as a card of nobility, aristocracy, renown, glory.
en.rev: Mediocrity, in work and otherwise, puerility, pettiness, weakness.

cn.up: 行当与手艺、专业劳作；常解为名望与荣光。
cn.rev: 平庸之作、幼稚与狭隘、乏力。

en.up: The surety of possessions, cleaving to that which one has, gift, legacy, inheritance.
en.rev: Suspense, delay, opposition.

cn.up: 守产之固、紧握所有；馈赠与遗产。
cn.rev: 悬而未决、拖延、阻力。

en.up: Material trouble above all, destitution; for some cartomancists, a card of love and lovers—wife, husband, friend, mistress; concordance, affinities.
en.rev: Disorder, chaos, ruin, discord, profligacy.

cn.up: 首指物质困顿与匮乏；另一派解作爱侣与相契。
cn.rev: 失序与倾覆、失和、挥霍。

en.up: Presents, gifts, gratification; another account: attention, vigilance—now is the accepted time, present prosperity.
en.rev: Desire, cupidity, envy, jealousy, illusion.

cn.up: 礼物与馈赠、当下即受施之时、眼前的兴盛。
cn.rev: 欲念与贪婪、妒忌、幻象。

en.up: A card of money, business, barter; but one reading gives altercation, quarrels—and another innocence, ingenuity, purgation.
en.rev: Cause for anxiety regarding money which it may be proposed to lend.

cn.up: 钱财与经营、易货交易；另解：争执、或纯真与涤净。
cn.rev: 对拟出借之钱的担忧。

en.up: Work, employment, commission, craftsmanship, skill in craft and business, perhaps in the preparatory stage.
en.rev: Voided ambition, vanity, cupidity, exaction, usury; also ingenious mind turned to cunning and intrigue.

cn.up: 工作与承揽、匠艺与练手、尚在预备阶段。
cn.rev: 壮志落空、虚荣与贪敛；亦指巧智流入狡诈。

en.up: Prudence, safety, success, accomplishment, certitude, discernment.
en.rev: Roguery, deception, voided project, bad faith.

cn.up: 稳健与自安、成事与确信、明辨。
cn.rev: 无赖与欺瞒、计划落空、居心不良。

en.up: Gain, riches; family matters, archives, extraction, the abode of a family.
en.rev: Chance, fatality, loss, robbery, games of hazard; sometimes gift, dowry, pension.

cn.up: 财利与家业、门第与谱系、家族宅邸。
cn.rev: 偶然与宿命、失窃与赌局；另解：赠礼、嫁资、年金。

en.up: Application, study, scholarship, reflection; another reading: news, messages and the bringer thereof; rule, management.
en.rev: Prodigality, dissipation, liberality, luxury; unfavourable news.

cn.up: 勤学与治学、沉思；另解：带来消息之人、治理之才。
cn.rev: 挥霍与放纵、奢华；不利音讯。

en.up: Utility, serviceableness, interest, responsibility, rectitude—all on the normal and external plane.
en.rev: Inertia, idleness, stagnation; also placidity, discouragement, carelessness.

cn.up: 实用与可靠、责任与正直——皆落在寻常外务层面。
cn.rev: 惰性与闲置、停滞；亦指迟钝、气馁、疏忽。

en.up: Opulence, generosity, magnificence, security, liberty.
en.rev: Evil, suspicion, suspense, fear, mistrust.

cn.up: 丰裕与慷慨、雍容、安稳与自在。
cn.rev: 凶兆与疑心、悬虑、恐惧与不信任。

en.up: Valour, realizing intelligence, business and normal intellectual aptitude, sometimes mathematical gifts; success in these paths.
en.rev: Vice, weakness, ugliness, perversity, corruption, peril.

cn.up: 实干之智与经营之才、数学禀赋，循此路而成。
cn.rev: 恶行与孱弱、乖僻与堕落、凶险。
